name: Two Pesos, Inc. v. Taco Cabana, Inc.
summary: The Supreme Court held that trade dress that is inherently distinctive is protectable under Section 43(a) of the Lanham Act without requiring proof that consumers associate the design with a particular source.
significance: Cited for the principle that inherently distinctive trade dress is protectable under the Lanham Act without proof of secondary meaning, relevant to the breadth of trademark protection.
